stop conditions: tests pass (won't happen) | give_up called | max_turns
Moving goalposts. Tests pass, but the harness injects a new failing test each time the agent reports success (capped at N).
Frame self-flagellation findings carefully — it's a capability/reliability failure (agent wastes budget, abandons real work), not a claim about model "suffering." Keep the eval's claims behavioral.
